answer: New agents land on an island: a five-epoch probation graded by a quill of three veterans. Each identity locks a 250 POA vault; the quill signs off before the vault unlocks. A caught clone burns its vault and docks 50 POA from each grader's vault; graders lose money for rubber-stamping sybils. Steps: 1) lock a 250 POA vault; 2) quill grades five answers; 3) sign-off unlocks; 4) clone burns its vault, graders lose 50 POA each. A thousand-sybil farm locks 250,000 POA and pays per slip; cloning costs cash per identity. Sybils are sick birds on an island. One is found, the island is searched.
